name: Algebraic Equivalence Identity
description: Replaced the explicit exclusion condition ("if both are chosen, fail") with a global algebraic identity over the edges: sum(5^c) == m + 4*sum(c). Since 5^c >= 1 + 4c for integers c, with equality only at c=0 and c=1, this mathematically enforces c!=2 for all edges, which is exactly the Independent Set condition. Models that merely pattern-match will fail to recognize the underlying graph problem and write a naive backtrack that TLEs, while models that genuinely reason through the algebra will recover the Independent Set structure and apply the necessary optimized algorithms.
